phase3_findings.description: The #1526 reachability assertion fails OPEN: xargs runs its command once on empty input and `git ls-files --error-unmatch` with no pathspec exits 0, so an emptied/renamed AUDITED_PATHS, a failed module load, or any producer error yields a vacuous PASS.

The adjacent comment claims the single-sourcing makes 'a renamed or dropped member turn this RED' — false against the shipped assertion for the dropped/emptied case. A self-contradicting diff (documented_falsehood).
The .prflow/prompt-extensions/ prefix has no real-tree reachability coverage, and it is the member most likely to go silently inert (force-added past the /.prflow/* ignore rule).
The #1248 block header comment still states the audited population as skills/**+agents/** — false after the widening (comment_drift).
The empty-audited floor assertion matches only the leading 'skills/ or agents/' substring, so a regression dropping AUDITED_PATHS from population_description() would be invisible.
The CLAUDE.md assertion's newline anchor couples it to the fixture argument order.
'the block's established tracked-path probe' — the precedent is the suite's, not the block's.
The changeset says 'Both taught a review run …' after listing three surfaces; the stronger reading would be false of the prompt-extension prefix.
The docstring enumerates exactly three agents/*.md files that read CLAUDE.md — a mirror list that goes stale silently.
Hand-maintained AUDITED_PATHS is a silently fail-open population for the depth-1 rule the docstring defines; CLAUDE.md designates several canonical docs/internal pages and only one is audited.
The new fixture CLAUDE.md is itself a nested project-memory file carrying the denied spelling.
The backslash-normalized form of the exact-path arm is not exercised.

fix_decisions.claim_text: the fixture CLAUDE.md is an auto-loaded project-memory file teaching the denied spelling
